titulo: Quiz — One drink named, and the dish you did not order
subtitulo: The izakaya seat, the otoshi, and who pays
introPt: Two travellers get through an opening round and a goodbye without a single surprise.
cenario: A neighbourhood izakaya at half past eight, full and loud.

dialogo.es: 何か飲みますか？ カウンター席もありますよ。
dialogo.pt: Having something to drink? There are counter seats too.
dialogo.tts: 何か飲みますか？ カウンター席もありますよ。

dialogo.es: 生ビールをお願いします。カードは使えますか？
dialogo.pt: A draught beer, please. Can I use a card?
dialogo.tts: 生ビールをお願いします。カードは使えますか？

dialogo.es: すみません、現金のみなんです。
dialogo.tts: すみません、現金のみなんです。

dialogo.es: 分かりました。ここは私が払います。全部でいくらですか？
dialogo.pt: Understood. This one's on me. How much is it altogether?
dialogo.tts: 分かりました。ここは私が払います。全部でいくらですか？

perguntas.pergunta: A small dish you never ordered is placed in front of you at the izakaya. It is:
opcoes: A free gift from the house
The otoshi — a seat/cover charge added to the bill whether you eat it or not
perguntas.explica: お通し applies to everyone, usually a few hundred yen a head — the price of the seat, not a trick.

opcoes: Lawful house practice — a customary seat charge of a few hundred yen a head
A service charge added at the end
perguntas.explica: It is the cover charge in edible form; knowing it is coming turns a surprise line into a number you expected.

perguntas.pergunta: A small izakaya is cash only and refuses your card. Is that allowed?
opcoes: No, cards must always be accepted
Yes — no rule forces a small business to take cards; carry yen
perguntas.explica: A genkin nomi sign is ordinary and lawful; you usually pay at the register on the way out, and splitting (warikan) is normal.

opcoes: A draught to start with while the table reads the menu
perguntas.explica: A first draught is the ordinary opening order; nobody expects you to have decided everything at once.

perguntas.pergunta: When is koko wa watashi ga — this one's on me — best said?
opcoes: Early, before hands reach for wallets
perguntas.explica: Said early it settles the evening; said late it turns into arithmetic. Splitting with betsubetsu de is just as normal.
